summary: Final walkthrough documenting the restoration of DeanOS infrastructure, the deployment of IT Inventory and Evaiteclabs, the resolution of naming/resource conflicts, the implementation of automated self-healing and daily cloud backups, and the final push of all setup scripts to the 'zimaSetup' GitHub repository. This session has established a robust, reboot-persistent environment with a "one-click" restoration, monitoring, and redundant backup system.
